## COMPANY OVERVIEW

Zentrix Infotech is an India-based technology and digital marketing company founded in 2025.
The company specializes in building enterprise-grade digital solutions for businesses across
industries including healthcare, education, hospitality, e-commerce, interior design, real estate,
and retail.

With 250+ projects delivered and 270+ clients served, Zentrix Infotech has established itself
as a trusted digital partner for startups, SMEs, and growing enterprises. The company maintains
a 4.7/5 client satisfaction rating.

Core philosophy: "Transform Ideas Into Web Development Mastery" — enterprise-grade solutions
powered by cutting-edge technology, built on trust, transparency, and innovation.

for optimal performance and user experience. Includes corporate websites, e-commerce platforms,
landing pages, portals, and full-stack web applications.

URL: https://www.zentrixinfotech.com/services/ui-ux-designing
Beautiful, intuitive interfaces designed to engage users and drive conversions. Services include
wireframing, prototyping, user research, interaction design, and visual design for web and mobile.

URL: https://www.zentrixinfotech.com/services/mobile-development
Native and cross-platform mobile applications delivering seamless experiences on both iOS and
Android. Covers consumer apps, business apps, and enterprise mobility solutions.

### 4. Software Development
URL: https://www.zentrixinfotech.com/services/software-development
Comprehensive custom software solutions to improve business efficiency and drive innovation.
Includes CRM systems, ERP solutions, SaaS platforms, APIs, and automation tools.

URL: https://www.zentrixinfotech.com/services/digital-marketing
ROI-driven performance marketing including SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media management,

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Where is Zentrix Infotech located?
A: Zentrix Infotech has offices in Thane (Mumbai), Maharashtra and Ghaziabad,
   Uttar Pradesh. We serve clients across India including Moradabad, Delhi NCR,
   Lucknow, Agra, and Meerut.

Q: How much does a website cost at Zentrix Infotech?
A: Website development starts from ₹15,000 for basic business websites and scales
   based on complexity. E-commerce and custom web applications are priced based on
   features and timeline. Contact us for a free quote.

Q: Does Zentrix Infotech work with small businesses?
A: Yes. We work with startups, SMEs, and growing businesses across all budgets.
   Our packages are designed to be scalable — clients can start small and expand
   their digital presence over time.

Q: What makes Zentrix Infotech different from other agencies?
A: We combine web development and digital marketing under one roof, ensuring
   your website is built for both performance and visibility from day one.
   Every project includes dedicated support, transparent reporting, and ROI tracking.

Q: How long does it take to build a website?
A: A standard business website takes 2–4 weeks. E-commerce platforms take 4–8 weeks.
   Custom software and mobile apps are scoped based on requirements.

Q: Does Zentrix Infotech offer SEO services in Moradabad?
A: Yes. We offer local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, on-page SEO,
   technical SEO, and link building for businesses in Moradabad and across UP.

Q: Can Zentrix Infotech run Google Ads for my business?
A: Yes. We manage Google Search Ads, Display Ads, YouTube Ads, Shopping Ads,
   and Performance Max campaigns with full monthly reporting.

Q: Does Zentrix Infotech offer post-launch website support?
A: Yes. All web development projects include post-launch support. We also offer
   ongoing maintenance packages for updates, security, and performance monitoring.
